name: dbx160-bus-glue
description: Gentle dbx 160 leveling/glue for a mix bus: a LOW ratio (2:1) with light GR, where the feed-forward true-RMS VCA acts as a transparent leveler and slightly REDUCES crest (the gentle end of the dbx — the opposite character to the 4:1+ punch presets). compress 2.0:1, thresh -22, sc_filter OFF, gain makeup. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus: LUFS -17.18->-16.64 (+0.54), crest 17.17->16.69 (-0.48 — gentle leveling), low-band block-crest 17.14->15.52, LRA 2.44->1.88 (tighter), true-peak -0.99, centroid 1747->1756 (tone unchanged). The leveling/glue end of the dbx — contrast the 4:1 dbx160-drum-punch which RAISES crest.
intended_for: a mix bus / submix that wants subtle, transparent leveling + cohesion (a few dB of glue) rather than added punch
plugin_build: uaudio_dbx_160.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless & processes offline; the /Components/UAD dbx 160 twins PASS THROUGH offline, do not use them).
notes: compress ' 2.0:1' (leading space) and meter/sc_filter are string/bool enums -> apply_vst_preset.py only.

At low ratios (<=2:1) the dbx behaves as a transparent leveler and slightly LOWERS crest; at 4:1+ it flips to RAISING crest (punch). This preset is the gentle/leveling end -- for punch use dbx160-drum-punch.
Keep GR light (raise thresh toward unity); for a touch more cohesion drop thresh a few dB. Clean VCA -> no added harmonics. dbx 160 = MONO. Glue stage, not a master.
